title: Pay Order to Nauvoo City Treasurer for Stephen Markham, 3 September 1843
handwriting: Handwriting of Henry G. Sherwood and JS
source_note: JS as mayor, Pay Order, to Nauvoo city treasurer [William Clayton], for Stephen Markham, [Nauvoo, Hancock Co., IL], 3 Sept. 1843; handwriting of Henry G. Sherwood and JS; endorsement in handwriting of William Clayton; one page; JS Collection, CHL.
